title.zh: 【Extended 将把结算网络从 Starknet 迁移至 Arc，持有 USDT 等资产需兑换或提现】
title.en: 【Extended 将把结算网络从 Starknet 迁移至 Arc，持有 USDT 等资产需兑换或提现】

current_state.zh: On-chain perpetual futures platform Extended will migrate its settlement network from Starknet to Arc during the week of October 19, pausing deposits and withdrawals for about two hours, switching gas payments to USDC, and requiring users holding more than $1 of USDT or wBTC to convert or withdraw by October 21 or face account restrictions and possible forced liquidation.
current_state.en: On-chain perpetual futures platform Extended will migrate its settlement network from Starknet to Arc during the week of October 19, pausing deposits and withdrawals for about two hours, switching gas payments to USDC, and requiring users holding more than $1 of USDT or wBTC to convert or withdraw by October 21 or face account restrictions and possible forced liquidation.
